title: Strait of Hormuz News, November 12, 2026: Straits Daily Brief
point: Lists the strait as closed to commercial shipping, citing IMF PortWatch: 3 vessels on 8 Nov against a typical 85 a day.

title: How Many Ships Crossed the Strait of Hormuz Today? Live Transit Count
point: Status "Restricted": about 6.9 AIS-visible crossings a day in the past week against 84.8 before the crisis, and the ships that cross do so under US naval coordination, which the market rules exclude.

title: Iran Update: November 12, 2026
point: Iran keeps claiming mine strikes on the US-backed southern route, and UKMTO reported two projectile attacks on tankers in and near the strait.

title: Washington's $40 billion Hormuz insurance fix: zero takers
point: The US reinsurance facility covers only ships under US naval escort and had placed no cover. Without escort, ships have no war-risk cover, which is what an unescorted transit would need.

title: Hormuz shipping 'below normal, but not stalled': UKMTO
point: UKMTO counted 170 outbound and 155 inbound transits in a week. Traffic is moving, though mostly with US facilitation, so it does not yet meet "pre-conflict terms".

title: When will Strait of Hormuz be 'safe' for commercial shipping again?
point: Insurers say any remaining mine risk would keep cover away and traffic halted, so a return to normal terms waits on mine clearance.

title: SpaceX Stock: IPO Date, Share Price & News
point: Market cap about $1.92T after the 12 Nov session. Reaching $3T needs a rise of roughly 58% in seven weeks.

title: Initial public offering of SpaceX
point: IPO on 12 Jun 2026 at $1.77T. The shares jumped in the first days, then fell about 50% from that peak by late July.

title: SpaceX Stock Gains Ahead of 328M-Share Unlock
point: Lock-up expiries keep adding shares that insiders can sell, which weighs on the price.

title: Here's How Much a $5,000 Investment in SpaceX Stock Could Be Worth by November 2027
point: Median one-year analyst target is $245 (about $3.3T), above the threshold. But that is a 12-month target; the market closes on 31 Dec 2026.

title: SpaceX (NASDAQ:SPCX) Stock Falls 2.3% - What's Next?
point: Latest quarter beat estimates with revenue up 161% year on year; consensus "Moderate Buy" with an average target of $243.60.
